skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Handle whole and mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers and mixed numbers as whole-plus-fraction parts, subtract whole parts, and combine the resulting whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the minuend fraction is smaller than the subtrahend fraction.

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and write zero whole or zero fractional parts in conventional final-answer form.
